S103.title: Adding server-side intelligence with Private Cloud Compute

S104.title: Apple Intelligence device and storage requirements

S129.title: ML Kit Prompt API get started

S131.title: This project's Bonsai 4B/9B GGUF header parse

facts.claim: Apple Foundation Models provides the on-device Apple Intelligence model with a 4,096-token context per session; instructions, tools, schemas and outputs all consume that window.
facts.note: This is the system model, not custom Core AI models.

facts.claim: Private Cloud Compute exposes a 32K-token context and stronger reasoning, with a daily request limit.
facts.note: Requires network and Apple Intelligence eligibility.

facts.claim: Apple Intelligence requires iOS/iPadOS/macOS/visionOS 27 (2026) and uses up to 8-14GB of storage depending on device class.
facts.note: Storage includes multiple models/assets, not just the 3B LLM.

facts.claim: Core AI (iOS 27) runs .aimodel models on CPU, GPU or Neural Engine and integrates with Foundation Models sessions; a background inference entitlement exists.
facts.note: Requires iOS 27 and Xcode 27.

facts.claim: Core ML palettization supports 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 bits; per-grouped-channel palettization and 8-bit LUTs are available from iOS 18.
facts.note: ANE JIT decompression from iOS 17.

facts.claim: Core ML linear quantization supports 4-bit and 8-bit weights and 8-bit activations; A17 Pro/M4 can use INT8 activation compute on the Neural Engine.
facts.note: Activation quantization uses per-tensor scales.

facts.claim: MLX affine quantization supports 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 bits with group sizes 32, 64 and 128; MXFP4/8 and NVFP4 are also supported.
facts.note: MLX uses the GPU, not the Neural Engine.

facts.claim: Bonsai 2B decodes at 89.9 tok/s on iPhone 17 Pro Max with llama.cpp Metal and the PQ2_0 pack (0.52GB), batch 1, tg128.
facts.note: The file analyzed in this project is PTQ1_0 0.43GB, not PQ2_0.

facts.claim: Bonsai 4B and 9B decode at 39.8 and 22.3 tok/s on iPhone 17 Pro Max.
facts.note: Fastest pack per device; batch 1.

facts.claim: The Bonsai whitepaper reports an approximately 6GB per-app memory limit on iPhone 17 Pro Max; all three models fit.
facts.note: Apple does not publish this limit; device/OS dependent.

facts.claim: The Bonsai 2B PTQ1_0 file is 429,183,456 bytes with 1.8245 bits/param; the PTQ1_0 payload is 28 bytes per 128 weights (1.75 bit/weight).
facts.note: Confirmed by the project's GGUF parser and PrismML fork.

facts.claim: The Bonsai 4B GGUF header reports 4,205,751,296 parameters, 32 layers, 8 full-attention layers, 4 KV heads, and 32KiB KV per token.
facts.note: HTTP Range header parse; data section not downloaded.

facts.claim: The Bonsai 9B GGUF header reports 8,953,803,264 parameters, 32 layers, 8 full-attention layers, 4 KV heads, and 32KiB KV per token.
facts.note: HTTP Range header parse; data section not downloaded.

facts.claim: The Bonsai 4B PTQ1_0 file is 949,549,920 bytes, or 1.8062 bits/param including F32 tensors and metadata.
facts.note: Payload remains 1.75 bit/param.

facts.claim: The Bonsai 9B PTQ1_0 file is 1,997,486,976 bytes, or 1.7847 bits/param including F32 tensors and metadata.
facts.note: Payload remains 1.75 bit/param.

facts.claim: iPhone 17 Pro/Pro Max use A19 Pro with a 16-core Neural Engine and 12GB RAM.
facts.note: Apple does not publish TOPS.

facts.claim: iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max use A20 Pro (2nm) with a dual 16-core Neural Engine, 12GB RAM, and 50% higher unified memory bandwidth than A19 Pro.
facts.note: Bandwidth absolute value not published by Apple.

facts.claim: A20 Pro is reported to use a 96-bit memory interface; with 9600MT/s this yields about 115.2GB/s, consistent with Apple's +50% claim over a 64-bit 76.8GB/s A19 Pro.
facts.note: Leak + arithmetic; Apple has not published absolute bandwidth.

facts.claim: Galaxy S26 Ultra uses Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 with 12GB or 16GB RAM and Android 16 (upgradable to 17).
facts.note: Device specifications.

facts.claim: Pixel 11 Pro XL uses Google Tensor G6 with 12GB or 16GB RAM and Android 17.
facts.note: Device specifications.

facts.claim: Dimensity 9500 supports LPDDR5X 10667 and the NPU 990, with claims of over 2x token generation speed and 56% lower peak NPU power versus the previous generation.
facts.note: Vendor claims; absolute tok/s not given.

facts.claim: For planning, Android foreground-app budgets are about 3.5GB on 8GB devices, 5.5GB on 12GB devices, and 7.5GB on 16GB devices.
facts.note: Not an OS limit; LMK/zRAM/OEM dependent.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Gemma4-E2B (2,583MB) decode at 47 tok/s CPU / 52 tok/s GPU on Galaxy S26 Ultra and 25 CPU / 57 GPU on iPhone 17 Pro.
facts.note: Official LiteRT-LM benchmark table; batch 1.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Gemma4-E4B (3,654MB) decode at 18 tok/s CPU / 22 tok/s GPU on Galaxy S26 Ultra and 10 CPU / 25 GPU on iPhone 17 Pro.
facts.note: Official LiteRT-LM benchmark table; batch 1.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Gemma3-1B (1,005MB) decode at 33 tok/s CPU and 24 tok/s GPU on Galaxy S24 Ultra.
facts.note: GPU is slower than CPU for this small model.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Phi-4-mini (3,906MB) decode at 7 tok/s CPU and 10 tok/s GPU on Galaxy S24 Ultra.
facts.note: Large file, low tok/s.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Qwen2.5-1.5B (1,598MB) decode at 34 tok/s CPU and 31 tok/s GPU on Galaxy S25 Ultra.
facts.note: CPU slightly faster.

facts.claim: LiteRT-LM reports Qwen3-0.6B (586MB) decode at 9 tok/s CPU and 21 tok/s GPU on Vivo X300 Pro.
facts.note: CPU result may reflect a power-saving configuration.

facts.claim: Android NNAPI is deprecated as of Android 15; performance-critical workloads should migrate to LiteRT GPU/NPU or vendor delegates.
facts.note: NNAPI may fall back to CPU.

facts.claim: LiteRT NPU acceleration requires Android API 31+, arm64-v8a, and supported SoCs; Qualcomm support covers Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 and newer, MediaTek covers Dimensity 7300-9500.
facts.note: AOT/JIT and Play AI Pack are supported.

facts.claim: Google Play limits: base module 500MB, individual feature module 500MB, individual asset pack 1.5GB, cumulative 4GB for install-time content, 30GB for on-demand asset packs.
facts.note: 200MB+ apps show a mobile-data warning.

facts.claim: Gemini Nano Prompt API accepts under 4,000 input tokens, recommends outputs under 4K tokens, blocks background use, and enforces per-app quotas.
facts.note: Prompt API is beta and device-limited.

facts.claim: Gemini Nano support is device-specific and split across nano-v2/v3/v4; supported devices include Pixel 9/10/11 and Galaxy S25/S26 families.
facts.note: Feature-specific and Prompt APIs have different device lists.

facts.claim: Bonsai 2B has 12KiB KV per token (6 full layers, 2 KV heads, 256 key/value dims), so 262K context needs 3.0GiB of FP16 KV.
facts.note: 4B/9B use 32KiB/token and need 8.0GiB at 262K.

facts.claim: Qwen3 0.6B has 112KiB KV per token, so 32K context needs 3.5GiB, more than its 4-bit weights (0.31GiB).
facts.note: 28 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, FP16; config.

facts.claim: With 0.35GiB runtime, Bonsai 2B needs about 0.80GiB at 4K and 3.75GiB at 262K.
facts.note: Weights 0.40GiB; KV 0.05/3.0GiB.

facts.claim: Bonsai 9B needs about 3.21GiB at 32K and 6.21GiB at 128K, so 128K fits a 16GB Android budget but not an iPhone 6GB budget.
facts.note: Weights 1.86GiB; KV 1.0/4.0GiB.

facts.claim: Llama 3.2 8B at 4.5 bpw needs about 5.04GiB at 4K and 8.54GiB at 32K; the 32K case exceeds a 16GB Android planning budget of 7.5GiB.
facts.note: Weights 4.19GiB; KV 0.5/4.0GiB; runtime 0.35GiB.

facts.claim: Bonsai reports 0.125 vs 0.216 mWh per generated token at 9B on M5 Pro for ternary vs BF16, 1.7-2.0x lower energy.
facts.note: Board power includes GPU memory on M5 Pro.

facts.claim: Apple claims up to 40% higher sustained performance for iPhone 18 Pro versus the previous generation, aided by a 3x larger vapor chamber and side-by-side memory packaging.
facts.note: Sustained-performance claim; independent reviews vary.

facts.claim: Qwen3.5 2B uses a 3:1 hybrid layout (18 linear + 6 full attention), 2 KV heads, 256 key/value dims, so KV is 12KiB per token and 262K needs 3.0GiB.
facts.note: Same KV geometry as Bonsai 2B; Qwen3.5 2B 4-bit is 4.33GiB total at 262K.
